name: OAuth / SSO security review
description: Auth-flow focused. Captures every redirect chain. JWT decoder annotations on every captured token. SAML decoder available. Match&Replace rules pre-set to flag missing state / nonce / PKCE.
notes:
OAuth/SSO review. Look at every /authorize -> /callback hop.

Things the passive scanner will surface:
  - missing state param in /authorize
  - missing PKCE in mobile/SPA flows
  - weak JWT signing alg
  - alg=none acceptance
  - kid path traversal
  - jku/x5u pointing at attacker-controlled URLs

rules.name: flag missing state in oauth
rules.comment: VISIBLE flag: if you see [!NO-STATE-PARAM-DETECTED!] in a captured URL, the IdP accepted a request without state. Re-test that exact flow with PoC.
